name: Brâzil

attributes.attribute: a magical island of peace and plenty
ruled by King Bres or a fairy queen

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brâzil is a cross reference in this book. See Hy-Brâzil. That site was a magical island of peace and plenty in the ocean. A king named Bres or a fairy queen ruled it. The island appeared every seven years. The South American country of Brazil carries its name.

okr.objective: Route the reader from Brâzil to the island site Hy-Brâzil.
key_results: Brâzil is a cross reference entry.
Hy-Brâzil was a magical island of peace and plenty.
Brazil, the South American country, carries its name.
